The page and its pictures

ToOpArgsWho
Set the page's look and layoutgroup.editFace on the communityface: the page document as a JSON string, at most 16,384 bytes. Pictures don't go inside it.owner, admins
Set a picturehost.editMedia on the pageslot: mark · cover · logo · wallpaper; media: base64, at most 156,000 characters; mediaMime: image/png · image/jpeg · image/webpowner, admins on the page

An empty value clears. The easiest way to design a page is WallFlowers' own editor, in the app's community settings.
